title: Podcast Video Editor – Remote (Freelance/Part-Time)
description:
About 37 Projects

We are a leading video podcast marketing agency specializing in health and wellness content. We manage YouTube growth for top experts, nutritionists, and medical professionals, helping their content reach the right audience. Now, we’re looking for a Podcast Video Editor to join our team!



Role Overview

We need a highly skilled Podcast Video Editor who can turn long-form podcast recordings into engaging, well-paced video content. You will be responsible for cleaning up raw footage, cutting unnecessary parts, ensuring smooth pacing, enhancing audio, and making the final video visually polished and professional.



Your main goal is to edit full-length podcast episodes (30-90 minutes) and clips from those podcasts while maintaining a natural and engaging flow. Audio quality is just as important as video quality, so experience in audio enhancement and noise reduction is required.



Key Responsibilities

- Edit long-form podcast videos (30-90 minutes) into polished, high-quality content

- Cut out filler words, awkward pauses, and unnecessary sections to keep the conversation engaging

- Enhance and balance audio for clarity, reducing background noise and ensuring consistent levels

- Apply light audio processing (EQ, compression, noise removal) for professional sound

- Ensure smooth transitions, multi-camera switching (if applicable), and high production value

- Create shorter clips (3-10 minutes) from full episodes (timestamps will be provided)

- Deliver export-ready files in landscape (16:9) format



Who You Are

- Experienced Podcast Video Editor—you have edited long-form conversations before

- Proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Strong understanding of pacing & storytelling—you know how to keep viewers engaged

- Skilled in multi-camera editing, color correction, and professional podcast aesthetics

title: Deductions/Chargebacks Specialist
description:
Alpine Corporation is seeking a detail-oriented Marketplace Deductions & Compliance Analyst to support the monitoring, investigation, and recovery of retailer deductions across major online and retail partners including Amazon, Home Depot, Wayfair, Lowe’s, and other marketplaces.



This role will be responsible for identifying chargebacks, promotional deductions, and vendor funding discrepancies, and working internally with accounting, sales, and operations teams to verify validity and pursue recovery when appropriate.



The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience working with large datasets and retailer portals such as Amazon Vendor Central.



?



Key Responsibilities



• Monitor retailer payment reports and deduction activity across multiple sales channels

• Download and review deduction reports from retailer portals (Amazon Vendor Central, retailer portals, etc.)

• Maintain Alpine’s Deduction Audit Tracker, documenting all deductions, amounts, invoices affected, and deduction categories

• Investigate the validity of deductions including freight allowances, promotional funding, damage claims, shortages, and vendor funded discounts

• Work with internal teams (accounting, sales, operations) to verify whether deductions are valid

• Prepare documentation to dispute invalid deductions and submit disputes through retailer portals or designated processes

• Track deduction disputes and recovery status to completion

• Maintain organized records of deduction evidence including invoices, agreements, and supporting documentation

• Produce weekly deduction summary reports for management showing total deductions identified, disputed, and recovered

• Assist in identifying trends or recurring deduction issues and recommend process improvements



?



Qualifications



• Strong Excel / spreadsheet skills (pivot tables, data organization, reconciliation)

• High attention to detail and strong analytical mindset

• Experience working with e-commerce platforms such as Amazon Vendor Central preferred

• Familiarity with retailer chargebacks, deductions, or accounts receivable reconciliation is a plus

• Strong organizational and documentation skills

• Excellent written communication skills

• Ability to work independently and manage ongoing tracking processes



?



Key Performance Indicators



• Total deductions identified and documented

• Percentage of deductions reviewed and validated

• Amount of deductions successfully disputed or recovered

• Accuracy and completeness of deduction tracking reports

• Timeliness of reporting and dispute submission



Work Time : 8:00am - 5:00 pm PACIFIC time ( GRAVEYARD SHIFT )

title: Digital Content Designer (Canva)
description:
If you enjoy designing eye-catching presentations and content, following a clear creative process, and being measured on your results, keep reading.



About us:

We’re the Creade Club. We coach Sport-Creators to benefit more from their audience. Clients are mostly successful Sport-Creators who are having trouble improving their business further.



We’re now hiring Remote Canva Designers to help us build high-converting webinars. You do not have to write the webinar scripts or build the marketing strategy. Your job is simple: take the outlines and copy we provide and turn them into highly engaging slides and scroll-stopping graphics that hold our audience's attention.



What you’ll do:

- Design and format high-quality slide decks for live and automated webinars.

- Translate scripts and outlines into visually appealing presentations that keep viewers engaged.

- Make rapid revisions to slides and graphics based on feedback from the marketing team.

- Hit clear daily and weekly targets (slide decks completed, turnaround time, design quality).

- Keep our Canva workspaces, folders, and asset libraries perfectly organized.

- You are not running the webinars or writing the copy. Your focus is high-quality, high-converting design.

- A steady flow of detailed design briefs, slide outlines, and proven copy.

- Brand kits, presentation templates, and a library of our most successful past slide decks and creatives.

- Training on our specific customer avatar and the visual styles that appeal to them.

- Regular feedback so you can improve your design efficiency and visual storytelling.

- A clear progression path for top performers.



Pay and progression:

- A fixed monthly amount plus

- Additional pay/bonuses that increase with your output and creative performance.



Strong performers who consistently exceed targets can earn more and may be considered for more senior creative roles over time. Exact details of the structure, targets, and progression path are explained during the interview process.

- You like working within brand guidelines/templates and can adapt quickly based on creative feedback.

- You know how to pace a presentation visually.

- You have reliable internet, a working computer, a webcam, and a quiet place to work.



Requirements:

- Expert-level knowledge of Canva (specifically for building extensive presentation decks, advanced features, and file organization).

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Comfortable on Zoom and team communication platforms.

/t/6f5MPTTPdEus

title: Video Editor - Real Estate Property Overviews
description:
Note: This job starts as a gig and can continue as such, but if interested, it can become a full-time work.



About me:

I run a real estate brand on Spain's Costa del Sol that reviews new property developments - apartments, villas, off-plan projects - for international buyers.



I'm building a YouTube channel alongside a property website. Every development I cover needs a video, and that video lives in TWO places:



1. YouTube 

2. Embedded on my website



I need an editor who can produce both cuts from the same source footage, consistently, and who eventually starts suggesting improvements instead of waiting for direction. 



What you'll be editing:



For each development, I'll send you:

- 15–20 minutes of raw footage (drone, walkthroughs, exteriors, my on-camera segments)

- A structure to follow

- Reference images, floor plans, price tables for graphics



You'll deliver:

- YouTube cut optimized for retention. Thumbnail included (or willingness to learn).

- Website cut



Both cuts need: color correction, royalty-free music when it fits, on-screen graphics (prices, specs, floor plans, maps), and English subtitles. The videos will also need voice isolation/noise removing often (e.g road or car noise)



Turnaround: 48 hours (can be longer at the beginning while you learn what I'm expecting)



Style I'm aiming at:

Honest, calm, cinematic. The viewer should feel like they're being walked through by a knowledgeable human, not sold to.



What I'm paying:

$6/per hour of editing - can be increased based on skill. After a few edits we will see how long on average a video takes you. After a few successful videos I'd like to move to a monthly retainer with guaranteed volume, but I want to earn that relationship first, not promise it day one.



What I need from you:



- Preferably real experience editing REAL ESTATE (not an absolute must if you are editing something very similar)

- Fluent in (PREMIERE PRO / DAVINCI RESOLVE / FINAL CUT / OTHER POPULAR SOFTWARES - pick what you actually use)

- Visual taste (strong sense of pacing, you know when to hold a shot on a sea view vs when to cut)

- Reliable communication - I shouldn't have to chase you for status updates

- Initiative: after the first 5 videos, I want you proactively suggesting things like "this section dragged, here's a tighter version" or "we should add a graphic here"



How to apply:



1. Send links to 2–3 of your best video edits that you think could be useful for me to see your skills (longer form).

2. Tell me which software you use and how many years, and roughly how many videos you've edited in it.

3. At the top of your message, write the word "ESTEPONA". Applications without this word will be ignored.

4. Tell me your time zone and typical working hours.



Thanks. Looking forward to seeing your work.

: Building and maintaining automation scenarios that connect GHL with other tools

title: BIM Modeler - Revit Families
description:
Company: RD Studio (rdstudio.co)

Employment Type: Full-Time Freelance

Location: Remote (Targeting APAC / Southeast Asia)



RD Studio is an international BIM content company known for high-quality Revit families used by thousands of architects worldwide. We are expanding our team and looking for a Revit Family Modeler who specializes in complex, highly parametric content.



** Note **

We are specifically looking for advanced modelers. If you are a beginner or only build basic geometry without nested parameters, this role is not for you).





** What You’ll Do **

- Create professional, lightweight Revit families from scratch using nested families, complex formulas, and advanced constraints.

- Maintain strict quality: Follow our internal BIM standards for geometry, parameters, materials, and visibility.

- Draft diverse assets: Work on furniture, plumbing fixtures, lighting, electrical, structural, and more.

- Collaborate efficiently: Manage your workflow using Asana, Google Sheets, and shared QA checklists.



*** What We’re Looking For ***

- Advanced Parametric Experience: Proven ability to build highly flexible families (portfolio and .RFA samples are required).

- Technical Mastery: Deep understanding of shared parameters, reference planes, type catalogs, and mathematical/logical formulas.

- Professional Organization: Ability to structure and name parameters cleanly and logically.

- Work Ethic: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and comfortable with English documentation.

- Bonus: Experience modeling MEP or Structural content.





**** Why Join Us? ****

100% Remote: Work from home with flexible hours.

Skill Growth: Get consistent feedback from industry experts to elevate your BIM skills.

Career Progression: Long-term collaboration with the potential to grow into a Senior Modeler or QA Leadership role.





**** Location & Budget ***

This full-time freelance position is targeted toward candidates based in Southeast Asia (Philippines, Thailand, Myanmar, etc.), as our budget is benchmarked to competitive full-time freelance rates in these regions.





***** How to Apply *****

Send an
 to 

Subject: Revit Family Modeler — [Your Name]





Please include:

1. A short introduction about your experience with complex parametric modeling.

2. Your portfolio (PDF or link).

3. At least 5 sample Revit families (.RFA format) demonstrating your highest level of parametric complexity.

4. Your current availability for full-time work.

title: Screen-record 1-4 minute long how-to tutorials on your desktop

title: Video Editor — Viral Short-Form Series (3x/week)
description:
Video Editor — Viral Short-Form Series (3x/week)

Company: Tally (habit accountability app) Type: Freelance / contract, ongoing Volume: 3 videos per week Format: Vertical short-form (TikTok / Reels / Shorts), 45–75 seconds



About the project

We're launching a recurring viral short-form series for Tally — an app where people put real money on the line to break their bad habits. Miss your goal, lose your stake.

The series is a chaotic-comedy format: a wheel picks a follower, we DM their friends to expose their worst habit, we ambush them in public, and a raccoon mascot tackles them and steals 50 cents. It ends with a transformation shot showing the habit broken 14 days later.

Think MrBeast-style stunt structure meets AirrackTV pacing meets unhinged mascot energy. The format is built to be remixed weekly with different followers and different bad habits, so we need an editor who can lock in a repeatable visual system and crank out episodes fast.



The trial edit

Before we lock in the ongoing contract, we want a paid trial edit of Episode 1.

Reference video (match this format, pacing, energy, and editing style exactly): [
/p/DVsTZMkjXWh/?hl=en]



Script: Attached below. Follow it beat-for-beat.



Important — in the video provided, there were very few “in real life” clips used, most of the video was animations. Same here, there will only be the following “in real life”clips used from this point forward:

Conversation with friend

Going to roommate’s place of work

Raccoon beating him/her up and doing a signature dance to a signature song



THESE 4 CLIPS ARE NOT PROVIDED FOR THE TRIAL EDIT.



Instead, use a black background and overlay the dialogue in place for now. We are merely testing your animation and editing ability to be on par with the example provided.



Everything else is your job to build with animation, captions, and stock/filler footage:

Wheel spin animation landing on the username

Instagram profile screenshot reveal

DM screenshots stacking on screen (blurred names)

The "mold on a plate" photo (use a stock cringe photo or create a graphic)

All on-screen captions and text

The Ed Sheeran "Bad Habits" beat drop sync

End card with CTA



YOU MAY SPEED UP VOICE/ADD SOUND EFFECTS WHERE YOU SEE FIT, JUST MATCH THE FORMAT OF THE EXAMPLE!



Let the captions and animations carry the storytelling. The reference video does this constantly — that's the whole technique.



Deliverables for the trial:

1 finished vertical video (9:16, 1080x1920, mp4)

Captions burned in, styled consistently (white, eb garamond font, burgundy colored for emphasis words) // differentiate between different people talking

Music synced with beat drop on the Ed Sheeran 
nt

Project file (Premiere/CapCut/AE — whichever you use) for revisions



Turnaround: 24 hours

Pay for trial: $7



Ongoing role

If the trial is strong, you're hired for 3 videos per week in the same format. Each video uses the same skeleton:

Wheel spin ? follower picked

DM evidence stacking

IRL ambush at the victim's workplace/location (3–4 IRL clips per ep)

"Get him" ? raccoon tackle

50-cent steal + signature dance to "Bad Habits"

14-day transformation reveal

End card



The recurring beats mean once you build the templates (wheel, DM overlay, Tally notification, end card), each subsequent video should get faster to produce. We'll provide the script, the IRL footage, and any specific assets — you handle everything else.



What we're looking for

An editor who can match reference style precisely, lands captions and SFX with comedic timing, builds clean motion graphics (wheel spin, DM overlays, notification popups), syncs to music beats instinctively, and turns around fast without sacrificing polish. Short-form viral experience (MrBeast, Airrack, AlanChikinChow, prank/stunt creators) is a huge plus.



How to apply

Send:

2–3 examples of short-form work you've edited (links)

Software you edit in

Title + begin your message with “TALLY EDITOR” – this is to ensure you’ve read the entire description properly



Attached: Episode 1 script

I put every single one of my followers on this giant wheel, and whoever it picks is getting their worst habit exposed by a raccoon.

And the winner 
 lands. Screenshot of their profile pops up.]

I went through your entire Instagram and DM'd every single one of your tagged friends asking what your worst habit is.

[DMs stack on screen, blurred names]

They told us his name is John and he never washes the dishes. His roommate sent us a photo. There's mold growing on a plate from March.

[Cringe photo. Zoom in. Zoom in more.]

So I DM'd every single one of his friends asking what time he gets off his summer internship. Then I showed up outside Goldman Sachs at 6:47 PM.

[Cut to camera posted outside the building. People in suits walking out. John spots the camera.]

"Hi, uh... can I help you?" 

"Are you John?"

 "...yeah?"

 "Do you live with Marcus?"

 "How do you know Marcus —" 

"Marcus told us you haven't washed a dish since spring break."

 "He WHAT —" 

"John. Marcus can't eat. THe's losing weight. He's eating Chipotle every night because there's no clean bowls. Do you really want that for Marcus?"

 "I— I didn't—"

[John shakes his head, mutters something, walks away from the camera.]

[Beat. Camera slowly pans down and to the left. The raccoon is sitting there. Staring. Twitching.]

"...Get him."

[Raccoon nods. Bolts off-frame.]

[Cut to John walking down the sidewalk. The raccoon tackles him from behind in a full sprint.]

[Raccoon reaches into John's pocket. Pulls out two quarters. Holds them up to camera.]

[Phone buzzes in John's hand. Tally notification fills the screen: "Your stake is LIVE. $50 on the line."]

[BEAT DROP — "Bad Habits" by Ed Sheeran]

[Raccoon signature dance. Tail spin. Little fist pump. Bites the quarters.]

[Cut to image, 14 days later. Same apartment. Sparkling clean kitchen. Marcus eating actual food in the background, crying tears of joy.] – on video caption: “don't be a john. monetize your friends (ethically)”



Raccoon mascot in place of example video's mascot (make same animation, moving from side to side):

title: Comparison TikTok Editor for Trading Card Brand (Versus Content, Long-Term)
description:
WE NEED THE EDITOR WHO MAKES "THIS VS THAT" FEEL IMPORTANT



I am hiring a part-time TikTok editor for a fast-growing Trading Card Game (TCG) content brand. This post is for editors who specialize in comparison content: side-by-side, before/after, this vs that.



Comparison content is one of the highest-engaging formats on TikTok because it forces a comparison the viewer wants to resolve. We want editors who can produce "$1 pack vs $500 pack," "this fake vs real Charizard," "graded vs raw value comparison," "old set vs new set price growth," and similar formats.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- 10-12 comparison videos per day, Monday to Friday

- 30-60 second comparisons with strong split-screen, side-by-side, or sequential reveal structure

- Topics: price comparisons, real vs fake card detection, raw vs graded value, set vs set comparison, old vs new card art, opening different pack types

- Heavy use of split-screen, transitions, before/after wipes, freeze frames

- Output 9:16 vertical, deliver via Drive



STYLE REFERENCE




 
 on TikTok for brand energy. For comparison style specifically, look at side-by-side product comparison content on TikTok (sneakers, makeup, food). These are reference accounts only, not the brand you will be editing for.



REQUIREMENTS



- 6+ months short-form video editing experience

- Portfolio with comparison, before/after, or versus content

- Strong split-screen and side-by-side editing skills

- Comfortable with sync timing for parallel reveals

- Proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

- Available Mon-Fri, 5 days/week, around 1.5 to 2 hours/day

- Filipino editors preferred for timezone alignment



BONUS POINTS



- Knowledge of TCG market values and price tracking

- Motion graphics for animated price labels, value reveals, percentage growth

- Experience with reveal-pattern editing (slow build, sudden payoff)

- Familiar with Pricecharting, TCGplayer, eBay sold data



COMPENSATION



PHP 16,800/month (paid weekly at PHP 4,200 every Friday). 10-12 comparison videos/day x 5 days = 50-60 videos/week. Performance bonuses after 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



In your application include:

1. 2-3 portfolio links showing your best comparison or before/after editing work

2. Your usual turnaround time for one 30-60 second comparison edit

3. Confirm you can commit to 10-12 comparison videos/day, Mon-Fri

4. Pitch one comparison video idea for a TCG content brand in 2-3 sentences



Applications missing the pitch will not be reviewed.



SELECTION PROCESS



1. Review application within 48 hours

2. Short message exchange with shortlisted candidates

3. Final hire within 1 week

4. First week serves as paid trial. Meeting standards = continue. If not = part ways professionally, keep trial payment



Long-term role, minimum 3-month commitment expected.

title: E-Commerce Video Editor
description:
**Quick Summary**

**Daily Output:** 3–4 concepts per day (with revisions)

**Video Length:** Typically 60–200 seconds

**Focus:** High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

**Location:** Remote



## About the Role



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography, and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content. While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing, and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback. Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing, and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging, and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



## Key Responsibilities



### Daily Concept Production



Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



### AI-Assisted Product Cinematography



Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement, and seamless integration into real-world edits.



### Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration



Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design, and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



### AI Character & Voice Integration



Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers, and emotional delivery when required.



### End-to-End Post Production



Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, color grading, pacing, revisions, and final export delivery.



## Required Technical Stack



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



### AI Video Generation



* Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

* Kling

* Luma Dream Machine



### Voice / Character Tools



* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* D-ID



### Image Generation



* Midjourney v6+

* Leonardo.ai



### Editing & Post Production



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* CapCut Desktop



### AI Enhancement



* Topaz Video AI



## Requirements



### Speed & Efficiency



You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



### Understanding of Advertising



You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling, and what makes ads convert.



### Attention to Detail



You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion, or low-quality visual details.



### Strong English & Audio Awareness



Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers, or direct voice delivery properly.



### Work Ethic & Communication



Communication, reliability, speed, and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



A lucrative bonus structure is available for strong performers.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



* A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

* Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

* A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly



### Application Requirement



To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word:



**NEURAL**

LEVEL OF AI EDITING AND B-ROLL CREATION EXPECTED:

title: SEO Strategist
description:
We're looking for an experienced SEO Strategist to take ownership of organic search performance across our growing portfolio of clients. This is a strategic role where you'll be responsible for developing SEO roadmaps, running audits, guiding content direction, and driving measurable improvements in rankings and traffic.



You'll work closely with our content, development, and paid media teams to make sure SEO is woven into everything we do. We manage clients across a range of industries, so you'll need to be comfortable adapting your approach and balancing multiple accounts at once.



We want someone who thinks beyond just keywords and rankings. You should be able to connect SEO activity to real business outcomes, communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, and spot opportunities that others might miss.



What You'll Do

- Develop and execute SEO strategies tailored to each client's industry, audience, and goals

- Conduct technical SEO audits covering crawlability, site speed, schema markup, and indexation

- Perform keyword research and competitive analysis to shape content planning

- Manage on-page optimisation including meta data, internal linking, and content structure

- Build and manage link acquisition strategies through outreach, digital PR, and partnerships

- Monitor organic performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and tools like Ahrefs or SEMrush

- Collaborate with content writers and developers to bring SEO recommendations to life

- Deliver monthly performance reports with clear insights, trends, and recommended next steps

- Stay on top of algorithm updates and proactively adjust strategies

- Log all time against client tasks in our project management system



What You'll Bring

- At least 4 years of hands-on SEO experience, covering technical, on-page, and off-page SEO

- A proven track record of improving organic rankings and traffic across multiple clients or brands

- Strong proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, and at least one major SEO platform (Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Moz)

- Experience running technical site audits and translating findings into clear, prioritised action plans

- Agency or multi-client environment experience preferred

- Strong written and spoken English



Nice to Have

- Experience with local SEO, including Google Business Profile optimisation

- Familiarity with CMS platforms like WordPress, Shopify, or Webflow

- Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for hands-on on-page changes

- Experience with reporting or data visualisation tools like Looker Studio



The Kind of Person We're Looking For

- Strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture, not just chase individual keywords

- Confident communicator who can explain SEO in plain language to clients and colleagues

- Self-motivated and organised, comfortable managing multiple accounts without close supervision

- Curious and proactive about staying current with search industry changes

title: Meta Ads Specialist (B2C Lead Gen) – 1-Month Paid Trial (Part-Time)
description:
Base Monthly Salary: $300 – $500 USD / Month

Job Type: Part-Time (approx. 15/week) with potential to scale to Full-Time as the business grows.

Industry: Medical Tourism / High-Ticket B2C Lead Generation



IMPORTANT: READ THIS FIRST BEFORE APPLYING

To prove you have excellent attention to detail and have actually read this job post, please start your cover letter or application message with the exact words: "I AM A LEAD GEN EXPERT." If you do not include this exact phrase at the very top of your application, it will be automatically rejected.



About Us

We are an independent, consumer-facing digital media and information hub specializing in high-ticket medical tourism. Specifically, we educate and nurture UK consumers looking for premium, life-changing aesthetic dental treatments abroad (such as smile makeovers, implants, and veneers) at a fraction of UK costs.



Our business model is pay-per-lead (B2C). Our most successful customer acquisition strategy involves organizing live, face-to-face consultation pop-up events across major cities in the UK. Partner clinics fly their medical teams into the UK, and we drive highly qualified local prospects to book free, in-person consultations at these events. This high-touch model builds massive trust and drives incredible booking and sales conversion rates.



We are looking for a sharp, metrics-driven Meta Ads Specialist based in the Philippines to own the strategy, creation, and optimization of our
 and Instagram lead generation campaigns for these UK events.



Your Responsibilities

Campaign Setup & Structure: Build, launch, and manage Meta ad campaigns specifically targeting localized UK audiences to book appointments for upcoming live events.



Full Asset Creation: You will be responsible for drafting highly persuasive, direct-response ad copy hooks and designing/sourcing the static imagery for the ads.



Video Creative Direction: While we will provide raw footage or edited video assets, you must provide the creative direction, scripting guidance, and hook ideas based on what is performing in the account.



Lead Generation Funnels: Run, test, and optimize both Meta Native Lead Forms (Instant Forms) and custom landing page conversion funnels.



Optimization & Lead Quality Management: Ruthlessly monitor and optimize campaigns daily to maintain a low Cost Per Lead (CPL) while maximizing intent and lead quality.



Tracking & Tech: Ensure Meta pixels, Conversions API, and custom tracking parameters are flawlessly implemented.



Requirements (Must-Haves)

Proven B2C Lead Gen Experience: You must have a track record of driving direct consumer leads (not just e-commerce ROAS or brand awareness). Experience in high-ticket service lead gen, aesthetics, medical, or dental is a massive plus.



High-Level English & Copywriting: Your written English must be flawless, with a strong understanding of UK consumer psychology, pain points, and direct-response hooks.



Automation Familiarity: Understand how lead data moves. You don't need to be a developer, but you must understand how Meta forms connect to CRMs (via tools like webhooks, Make, or Zapier) to ensure zero lead latency.



How We Will Work Together (The 1-Month Paid Trial)

We believe in letting the work speak for itself. We will select top candidates for a paid 1-month trial on a part-time basis.



First 2 Weeks: Audit our current setup, map out the creative/copy strategy, build out assets, and build the campaign structure for an upcoming UK event.



Remaining Weeks: Run the campaign live with a dedicated testing budget, optimizing for high-intent bookings.

If your communication is sharp, your technical skills are solid, and the campaign shows strong potential, this will immediately convert into an ongoing, part-time monthly retainer, with the opportunity to transition to full-time as our business grows.



How to Apply

If you match the criteria above, reply with:



The secret keyword mentioned at the top of this post.



Specific examples of B2C Lead Gen campaigns you have personally run. Do not just give us generic definitions. Tell us:



What industries/campaigns did you run?



What exact funnel architecture did you use (e.g., Native Forms, Multi-step landing pages, Quiz funnels)?



What specific quality metrics were you measured on by your clients (we don't want vanity metrics like impressions or CTR—give us the data that actually moves the business needle).



Your target monthly rate for part-time campaign management.



Your WhatsApp number.

title: Top-Tier Motion Graphics & Video Editor for Investigative YouTube Docs (Long-Term / Vox Style)
description:
We are launching a high-end investigative documentary channel. Our content dives deep into historical mysteries, economic shifts, and tech phenomena. We do not use "talking heads" or vlog-style footage. Our stories are told entirely through premium motion graphics, map animations, archival footage, and professional voiceovers—similar to the style of Vox, Fern, Johnny Harris, or Simplicissimus.



The Opportunity & Payment Structure:

We are not looking for a one-off freelancer; we are looking for a long-term creative partner to build this channel with us from the ground up.



Base Pay: You will be paid on a per-video basis (videos will be 10-30 minutes long). Your salary depends on multiple factors from $ 80 USD - $ 200 USD per Video. 



Performance Bonuses: We want you to grow with the channel. Once the channel reaches monetization and hits specific viewership milestones, you will receive additional success-based bonuses for top-performing videos, with up to (depending on the success of the channel) $ 1000 USD on top per video just for you. 



What We Expect From You:



Software Mastery: You must be highly proficient in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro.



Excellent English comprehension (you will edit to an English voiceover track).



The "Look": You understand the modern "Video Essay" aesthetic. You know how to make still images dynamic (parallax) and how to explain complex data through simple, elegant animations.



Attention to Detail: Timing is everything. Your edits must perfectly match the emotional beats of the voiceover. You can do your own sound design and color grading to create a cinematic atmosphere.



???? THE MANDATORY APPLICATION TEST

We receive hundreds of applications from people who do not have the specific skills for this niche. To prove you are the right fit, you must complete two short 30-second test edits. We recommend to watch channels like "Fern" for inspiration. 



Below are the scripts. We have attached the recorded Voiceover audio files here, which are on purpose not perfect: 



Test 1: Storytelling & Atmosphere (ca. 30 Seconds)



The Script: "May 1845. Two of the most advanced ships of their time, the HMS Erebus and Terror, set sail from England. Their goal: to conquer the Northwest Passage. They were equipped with steam engines, iron-reinforced hulls, and enough food for three years. But just two months later, they vanished into the Arctic ice. Not a single soul of the 129 crew members would ever be seen alive again. What happened in the freezing darkness?"



Your Task: We want to see how you handle historical storytelling. Use archival photos, map animations, and add a subtle parallax (3D) effect to still images.



Audio: Add suitable background music and rich sound design (e.g., cracking ice, wind, creaking wood) to make the story immersive.



Test 2: Data Visualization & Context (ca. 30 Seconds)



The Script: "To understand the sheer scale of the 2008 financial collapse, we need to look at the derivatives market. While the entire global GDP at the time was roughly 60 trillion dollars, the unregulated derivatives market had ballooned to an incomprehensible 600 trillion. That is ten times the value of all goods and services produced on Earth in a single year. When the housing bubble burst, this invisible web of debt didn't just collapse—it dragged the entire global economy down with it."



Your Task: Do not use regular stock footage. Tell this entire 30-second segment using pure motion graphics, charts, and text animations in After Effects. Show us how you visualize the massive difference between 60 Trillion and 600 Trillion. Keep the design clean, modern, and minimal.



How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY):

To ensure you have read this entire job post and have attention to detail, please make the subject line of your message exactly: "Blue Folder: Motion Editor"



In your application, you must include:



The Test Edits: Links to your rendered versions of Test 1 and Test 2 (Google Drive or unlisted YouTube links).



Your Rate: Your expected flat rate (in USD or PHP) for editing one highly polished 10 to 30 minute video in this style.



Your Portfolio: Links to max. 3 of your best videos that show motion graphics or documentary-style editing. (Please do not send gaming montages or wedding videos).



Quick Questions: What editing software do you use? What is your favorite YouTube channel and why?



Applications that do not follow these instructions or do not include the test edits will be automatically deleted. 



We look forward to building something massive with you!!

title: Lifecycle & Email Manager Reformly (E-Commerce & Mobile App)
description:
About Reformly

Reformly is a rapidly growing international e-commerce brand on a mission to help women become the best versions of themselves and feel confident in their bodies. We achieve this through our studio-quality, soft-minimalist Reformly Pilates Board bundled with our mobile app, offering guided workouts and a highly engaged community.



Operating on a high-performing recurring subscription model, we move fast. Founded in May 2025, we generated $4.3M in international sales in our first 12 months and currently have over 3,500 active subscriptions. We are an ambitious team looking for a creative and data-driven powerhouse to take full ownership of our post-purchase customer journey.





The Role: Mission

To take full, autonomous ownership of Reformly’s customer lifecycle, community engagement, and visual brand communication. By blending world-class Figma design with highly persuasive copywriting, you will elevate our brand identity, drive revenue through Klaviyo and app push notifications, and foster a deeply engaged in-app community. Your ultimate goal is to proactively maximize customer Lifetime Value (LTV), reduce subscription churn, and deliver high-converting creative assets for our Meta ads, completely owning the strategy and execution from day one.





Tasks & Responsibilities

You will be the architect behind our customer retention and visual communication. Your core focus areas include:

-
 & SMS Marketing (Klaviyo)

- App Push Notifications & Lifecycle Management

- Performance Ad Creation (Meta)

- Brand Design & Visual Asset Creation

- Community Management





Expected Outcomes (First 12 Months)

We measure success by hard results. In your first year, you are expected to:

1. Drive
 Revenue Growth: Increase
 marketing’s contribution from 30% to 40% of the total company revenue by proactively improving automated flows, weekly campaigns, retargeting, segmentation, and overall promotional strategy.



2. Maximize Customer Lifetime Value (LTV): Increase the average LTV from $130 to $250. Achieve this by driving deep daily engagement through the app, push notifications, and targeted
 sequences, ensuring customers consistently renew their 12-week subscriptions and engage with upsells.



3. Crush Subscription Churn: Reduce the overall churn rate from 18% to 12%. Take full ownership of the in-app community, optimize the post-purchase onboarding journey, and execute high-impact winback campaigns to keep users actively engaged with their Pilates board and the app.



4. Scale Meta Ads via High-Volume Creative Testing: Conceptualize, design, and launch a minimum of 5 new static Meta ad sets per week. Establish a rigorous creative testing feedback loop that consistently identifies at least 1-2 scalable "winning" creatives per month, maintaining an overall Customer Acquisition Cost (CPA) below $100 and a Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) above 1.80.





Who You Are (Competencies)

- Ownership & Initiative: Takes full responsibility for
 performance. Does not wait for instructions, but proactively starts projects, finds opportunities, and builds systems to reach the agreed goals.



-
 Marketing Expertise: Strong understanding of flows, campaigns, Klaviyo/email platforms, segmentation, retargeting, deliverability, lifecycle marketing, and A/B testing.



- Conversion-Focused Figma Design: Experienced designer in Figma who can create premium, mobile-first
s that use hierarchy, spacing, visuals, CTAs, testimonials, offers, and product education to drive purchases.



- Copywriting & Customer Psychology: Strong copywriter who understands hooks, subject lines, persuasion, objections, awareness stages, customer desires, and Reformly’s brand voice. Copy should feel human, sharp, and conversion-focused.



- Data Analysis: Comfortable with numbers and reporting. Uses open rate, CTR, CVR, revenue per recipient, unsubscribe rate, flow performance, and customer behavior to make decisions.



- Structured Execution: Organized, reliable, and able to manage a fast-moving campaign calendar, testing roadmap, flow improvements, and reporting without chaos.





Our Core Values

We hire, reward, and fire based on our core values. Do not apply if you do not fiercely align with these:

- All-In Mentality: Cares deeply about results and wants to help build Reformly into a leading at-home Pilates and wellness brand.



- Extreme Ownership: Owns outcomes fully. When
 is their responsibility, the team can trust it will be handled properly.



- Proactivity Over Waiting: Brings ideas, solutions, tests, and improvements without needing constant direction.



- Radical Candor: Communicates directly, honestly, and clearly. Flags problems early and brings solutions.



- Humble & Hungry: Ambitious, coachable, positive, and constantly looking for ways to improve themselves and the business.





How to Apply

We do not read standard cover letters. To apply, please submit a Video Application and your Portfolio covering the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself on video.



2. Why you are a perfect fit for this specific role and our core values.



3. A quick tour of your workspace so we can see how you structure your daily environment.



4. A link to your Figma Portfolio showcasing your best
 designs, social ads, and copywriting examples. Ensure the link is set to public.

CAN YOU TURN A COMPLEX TOPIC INTO A 30-SECOND TUTORIAL?



I am hiring a part-time TikTok editor for a fast-growing Trading Card Game (TCG) content brand. This post is for editors who specialize in structured, step-by-step tutorial content.



Tutorial content drives saves and shares, which TikTok rewards heavily in the algorithm. We want editors who can take a complex topic (how to grade a card, how to spot a fake, how to value your collection) and turn it into a tight, scannable 30-second walkthrough that viewers actually finish.



WHAT YOU WILL EDIT



- 8-10 tutorial videos per day, Monday to Friday

- 30-60 second step-by-step tutorials with numbered steps, clear text, screen recordings, or animated overlays

- Topics: "how to grade your cards," "how to spot a fake Charizard," "how to value your collection," "how to open packs to maximize chase rate," "how to use Pricecharting," and similar

- Strong structural editing: clear intro hook, numbered steps, payoff conclusion

- Output 9:16 vertical, deliver via Drive



STYLE REFERENCE



Study tutorial-style creators on TikTok across niches (cooking, tech, beauty, finance). Look for editors who use numbered overlays, step transitions, and clear progression. 
 
 for our brand energy reference, but adapt tutorial structure from broader TikTok creators. These are reference accounts only, not the brand you will be editing for.



REQUIREMENTS



- 6+ months short-form video editing experience

- Portfolio with step-by-step or how-to content (even outside TCG niche)

- Strong text overlay and number/step visualization skills

- Comfortable with screen recording integration if topic requires it

- Proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

- Available Mon-Fri, 5 days/week, around 1.5 to 2 hours/day

- Filipino editors preferred for timezone alignment



BONUS POINTS



- Knowledge of TCG (any: Pokemon, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh, sports cards)

- Past work editing for tutorial-heavy creators (tech, cooking, DIY, finance)

- Motion graphics for step transitions

- Experience with animated overlays and process visualization



COMPENSATION



PHP 16,800/month (paid weekly at PHP 4,200 every Friday). 8-10 tutorial videos/day x 5 days = 40-50 videos/week. Lower daily volume because tutorial structure requires more thought. Performance bonuses after 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



In your application include:

1. 2-3 portfolio links showing your best tutorial or how-to short-form work

2. Your usual turnaround time for one 30-60 second tutorial

3. Confirm you can commit to 8-10 tutorial videos/day, Mon-Fri

4. Describe how you would structure a 45-second "how to spot a fake Charizard card" tutorial (hook, steps, payoff)



Applications missing the structure exercise will not be reviewed.



SELECTION PROCESS



1. Review application within 48 hours

2. Short message exchange with shortlisted candidates

3. Final hire within 1 week

4. First week serves as paid trial. Meeting standards = continue. If not = part ways professionally, keep trial payment



Long-term role, minimum 3-month commitment expected.

title: AI Vibe Coder & Agentic Engineer ($500/mo to start)
description:

We're building an ecosystem of AI agents from scratch, Claude, Codex, Cursor, MCP servers, custom pipelines, to design, build, ship, and maintain these ventures. We need someone who can plug into that ecosystem and become an operator inside it.



What is a "vibe coder"?



It is someone who builds working software by directing AI tools instead of typing every line by hand. You describe what you want, you read what the AI produces, you test it, you push back when it is wrong, you ship it. You do not need a CS degree but developers are a bonus***. You need taste, judgment, and the ability to learn fast.



What you will actually do**



- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) to build and ship features across our ventures

- Orchestrate AI agents to run repeatable workflows (research, code review, content, deployment)

- Read code carefully enough to know when the AI is lying to you

- Run tests, fix bugs, deploy to Vercel / similar platforms

- Document what you build so the next AI session can pick up where you left off

- Work directly with the founder on whatever venture is hot that week



**Who we are looking for**



- Obsessed with AI tools, you already use ChatGPT or Claude daily for non-trivial work

- Can read JavaScript, Python, or TypeScript well enough to debug — you do not need to write it from scratch

- Comfortable in a terminal (git, npm, basic bash)

- Fast learner, when you hit something new, you figure it out in hours, not weeks

- Written English strong enough to write clear prompts and clear documentation

- Honest about what you do not know



**Bonus (not required)**

- Have shipped something, anything, built with AI assistance (show us)

- Familiar with MCP, agent frameworks, or n8n / Zapier-style orchestration



**How to apply**



Do not send a generic cover letter. Send:



1. A link to one thing you built with AI help (even small — a script, a site, a Chrome extension)

This is a long-term remote role for someone who is excellent at turning messy information into clear systems.



You will help document workflows, organize requests, prepare summaries, create templates, and keep open loops visible so our small but growing pediatric practice can run more smoothly.



Orchid Pediatrics is a pediatric developmental and behavioral health practice focused on thoughtful, family-centered, neurodiversity-affirming care. We support children, teens, and families with complex developmental, behavioral, and neurodivergent needs.



This role is based on the Operations Implementation Assistant position we outlined for Orchid Pediatrics, including support with inbox systems, professional request tracking, SOPs, Notion dashboards, Google Drive organization, vendor tracking, and weekly reporting.

This is not a clinical role.

This is not a social media role.

s

Required Skills

Personal Qualities We’re Looking For

description:
Job Title: Certified Bookkeeper

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time / Part-time / Contract

Reports To: CFO



About Us

Our company believe retail owners should spend their time curating inventory, building communities, and scaling their brands—not drowning in spreadsheets and register tape.



Job Summary

We are seeking an organized, detail-obsessed Certified Bookkeeper (CB or CPB) to manage our daily financial operations. In this role, you will be the anchor of our financial records, ensuring every transaction is perfectly recorded, reconciled, and optimized.

Because you are certified, we trust you to look beyond simple data entry—we need someone who understands depreciation, can catch and correct ledger errors independently, and will collaborate seamlessly with our external CPA at tax time.



Core Responsibilities

Ledger Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date daily entries across all accounts using double-entry bookkeeping in Quickbooks.



Reconciliations: 

Perform monthly bank, credit card, and merchant account reconciliations; research and resolve any discrepancies immediately.

Accounts Payable & Receivable: Oversee the full AP/AR cycle—invoice clients, track collections, verify vendor bills, and schedule authorized payments.

Payroll Administration: Process bi-weekly payroll for [number] employees, tracking deductions, benefits, and ensuring accurate local/state/federal payroll tax withholding.

Financial Reporting: Generate monthly and quarterly balance sheets, profit & loss (P&L) statements, and cash flow reports for leadership.

Year-End Prep: Maintain pristine financial records throughout the year and prepare clean financial binders/exports for our CPA's tax filing.



Qualifications & Skills

Certification Required: Active Certified Bookkeeper (CB) credential or Certified Professional Bookkeeper (CPB).

Experience: [2–5+] years of full-charge bookkeeping experience.

Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in [QuickBooks Online / Xero] and intermediate-to-advanced Microsoft Excel skills (vlookups, pivot tables).

Attention to Detail: A natural instinct to spot numerical inconsistencies and a drive to dig into data to solve them.

Integrity: Absolute discretion when handling sensitive financial, payroll, and personnel data.



Paid via PayPal - weekly on Friday

title: YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content)
description:
# YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content)



## Position Type



Part-Time / Ongoing Contractor



---



## About This Role



We have an existing editor and are building a reliable, long-term team. This is not a desperate replacement gig — we're looking for someone who can grow with the channel, deliver consistently, and become a trusted part of our production workflow.



---



## Compensation



Per-package pricing (no video = no pay):



**Starting Rate (Trial + First Month):**

- $50 per video package

- Includes:

  - 1 long-form YouTube video (5–10 min final runtime)

  - 5–7 short-form vertical clips

  - 1 custom thumbnail



**Scaling Rate (After Proven Consistency):**

- $75–$100 per package after 4–6 successful deliveries

- Based on quality, reliability, and communication



**Additional standalone shorts:**

- $5 each

- $6–$8 if heavier editing or custom graphics required



**Payment Schedule:**

- Every 2 weeks

- Only for packages actually delivered and approved



---



## About The Channel



This channel focuses on:



- mortgages

- real estate

- financial education

- wealth-building concepts



The editing style should feel:



- modern

- clean

- high-retention

- professional

- trustworthy



The goal is NOT gimmicky or overhyped editing.



We want viewers to feel:

*"Clear, calm, confident guidance."*



Style references:



- Graham Stephan

- Ali Abdaal

- Mark Tilbury



---



## What You'll Be Editing



You will primarily edit:



- talking-head educational videos

- financial storytelling content

- mortgage strategy content

- real-world buyer scenarios



Typical long-form videos:



- 5–10 minutes



You will also create:



- YouTube Shorts

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok clips

- LinkedIn vertical clips



---



## Responsibilities



### Long-Form Editing



You will:



- remove mistakes, pauses, filler words

- tighten pacing for retention

- add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts

- add clean captions and text emphasis

- add occasional b-roll and overlays

- integrate provided infographics and visuals

- use light background music and subtle sound design

- maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style



### Short-Form Content



From each long-form video:



- identify strong hook moments

- create 5–7 vertical clips

- format properly for 9:16 platforms

- add captions and pacing optimized for retention

- create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video



**IMPORTANT:**

Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries.



### Thumbnails



You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video:



- clean, modern design

- clear focal point

- readable text at small sizes

- consistent with channel branding



### Visual / Graphics Work



You may occasionally:



- add simple motion graphics

- integrate charts and infographics

- use stock footage selectively

- organize visuals to improve understanding



Most visuals and scripts will be provided.



---



## Editing Style Requirements



We are looking for editors who understand:



- pacing

- storytelling rhythm

- educational retention

- visual clarity

- modern YouTube editing



This is NOT meme editing.



We prefer:



- clean cinematic pacing

- calm confidence

- modern documentary feel

- clarity over flashy effects



---



## NON-NEGOTIABLES



### Accuracy Matters



This is financial and mortgage content.



All:



- text

- numbers

- names

- graphics

- statistics



MUST match the spoken audio exactly.



Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit.



### Communication



We value:



- responsiveness

- reliability

- professionalism

- clear communication

- consistency



If deadlines change, communicate early. Silence is the fastest way to lose this role.



### Turnaround Expectations



Typical turnaround:



- 24–48 hours for long-form edit

- Revisions handled quickly



---



## Workflow



Typical workflow:



1. Long-form video delivered first

2. Revisions completed

3. Shorts created from approved final video

4. Thumbnail finalized



We are building:



- templates

- SOPs

- editing systems

- reusable assets



Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow.



---



## Included Resources



You will usually receive:



- raw footage

- script

- topic context

- visual references

- infographic assets

- branding direction



---



## Required Skills



- YouTube editing

- Short-form editing

- CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro

- Understanding of pacing and retention

- Good English comprehension

- Ability to follow detailed instructions

- Basic thumbnail design



Bonus:



- motion graphics

- advanced thumbnail design

- educational content editing

- storytelling instincts



---



## Important Notes



We are looking for:



- long-term relationship

- reliability

- someone who grows with the channel



This role may scale to:



- multiple videos per week

- additional responsibilities

- increased compensation over time based on consistency and quality



---



## Application Requirements



Please include:



1. 2–3 YouTube videos you edited

2. 2–3 short-form videos you edited

3. 1–2 thumbnail examples

4. Your editing software

5. Your turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video

6. Your rate per package (1 long-form + 5–7 shorts + 1 thumbnail)

7. Your internet speed

8. Your 
 or WhatsApp



**IMPORTANT:**

Start your application message with the word:



**"EVEREST"**



---



## Auto-Disqualifiers



We will not consider applicants who:



- Don't include the word "EVEREST" at the start of their message

- Don't include portfolio examples

- Quote rates wildly outside our range without explanation

- Take more than 48 hours to respond during the application process



---



## Trial Process



Selected editors will complete a paid trial edit.



The trial allows both sides to:



- test workflow

- test communication

- test editing style fit

- determine long-term compatibility



We value long-term consistency over short-term speed.

title: Content Producer & Creative Marketing Assistant
description:
About the Founder:

You'll be working directly with a multi-passionate Neurodivergent (AuDHD) founder who is an occupational therapist, keynote speaker, content creator, and neurodivergent creative based in Melbourne. She has a growing audience across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, an allied health practice she wants to scale, and a personal brand with serious untapped potential. She's full of ideas, has genuine talent across multiple lanes, and needs the right person to help turn that into consistent, strategic output. She's upfront about what she needs support with: staying consistent with content, managing brand and collaboration
s, and turning creative energy into structured marketing that actually grows both her personal brand and her practice. If you're someone who sees potential and gets genuinely excited about building something from the ground up, keep reading.



The Role

This is a creative, strategic, and execution-focused role. You won't just be completing tasks. You'll be actively contributing to the growth of two interconnected brands: a personal creator brand and an allied health practice. The founder needs someone who can deliver consistent, polished, high-quality work at pace, think independently, and bring ideas when they see opportunities.



Content Production & Video Editing:

Editing long-form YouTube videos and repurposing them into short-form clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts using CapCut. Creating on-brand, visually strong carousels, thumbnails, and graphics in Canva. Managing the full content pipeline from raw footage through to published post. Supporting podcast production, editing, and distribution across platforms. Maintaining and keeping the publishing rhythm steady.

The goal is simple: the founder creates the raw material, and you turn it into finished content that actually gets published.



Canva Design & Digital Products

Designing, building, and launching digital products (guides, workbooks, templates, toolkits, lead magnets, presentation slides) in Canva. Setting up sales pages, product listings, and
 marketing sequences to support launches. Bringing ideas for new products based on audience needs and market gaps. You need to be genuinely strong in Canva, not just "I can use Canva," but able to produce work that looks polished, modern, and on-brand with a good eye for layout, spacing, typography, and visual hierarchy.



Marketing & Growth Strategy:

Developing and executing social media strategies to grow the founder's personal brand, creator accounts, and allied health practice. Writing captions and post copy that sound warm, human, and engaging. Researching trends and adapting them in a way that fits the brand. Tracking content performance and suggesting improvements based on what's actually working. Supporting content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Substack, and podcast. Lead generation for the practice, including identifying referral pathways and outreach to potential referrers and collaborators. 



Brand Outreach, Partnerships & Growth

Proactively identifying and pursuing brand partnerships, sponsorships, and collaboration opportunities. Reaching out to brands, managing inbound partnership
s, negotiating deals, and following up. Researching brands that are a good fit and maintaining a brand outreach tracker. Helping develop and maintain a media kit. Identifying sponsorship and paid collaboration opportunities. The right person understands that creators don't grow only by posting. They also grow through pitching, partnerships, networking, and consistent follow-up.



Website, Scheduling & Admin

Updating and maintaining the business website (Wix). Content scheduling using Metricool. Light admin related to outreach, brand communications, and keeping the content calendar on track. Organising Google Drive folders and creating simple systems for content and marketing workflows.

As the company grows, this role will grow with it. You will be taught new skills and take on new responsibilities over time — but you have to be coachable and genuinely eager to learn. title: Accessible Podcast & Video Repurposing Assistant
description:
Orchid Pediatrics / With Dr. Joy is hiring an Accessible Podcast & Video Repurposing Assistant for a stable, long-term part-time contractor role supporting a weekly podcast and educational short-form content.



We are looking for someone thoughtful, reliable, detail-oriented, and strong at turning raw audio/video into clear, accessible, ready-for-review content.



This role supports content related to neurodivergence, PDA, autism, ADHD, parenting, disability-affirming care, developmental health, and pediatric/integrative healthcare.



This is not a generic social media manager role, content strategy role, funnel role, or clinical role.



You will help turn raw podcast episodes, videos, voice notes, and transcripts into polished content assets by:



* editing weekly podcast episodes

* cleaning up audio/video for clarity

* preparing transcripts and show notes

* pulling short clips from longer recordings

* creating reels/shorts from podcast or video content

* adding accurate captions

* drafting captions based on Dr. Joy’s words

* creating simple quote graphics, audiograms, or carousel drafts

* preparing alt text and accessibility notes

* organizing files, folders, and content assets

* flagging anything that may need clinical, privacy, accessibility, or tone review



This role is for someone who enjoys production, repurposing, organization, and thoughtful editing. The content strategy, offer mapping, funnel planning, clinical direction, and final approval will be handled separately.



You may be a strong fit if you have:



* podcast editing, video editing, or content repurposing experience

* experience creating reels, shorts, captions, transcripts, or audiograms

* strong written English

* excellent attention to detail

* reliable follow-through without constant reminders

* good judgment about what to edit, what to preserve, and what to flag

* comfort working with sensitive topics related to children, families, healthcare, disability, and neurodivergence

* an accessibility-aware approach to content creation

* the ability to preserve a creator’s voice instead of making content sound generic

* calm, clear communication

* comfort receiving feedback and making revisions



Nice to have:



* experience with Descript, Riverside, CapCut, Canva, Audacity, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, or similar tools

* experience supporting a podcast, YouTube channel, clinician, educator, therapist, coach, or healthcare-adjacent business

* experience with neurodiversity-affirming, disability-aware, trauma-informed, parenting, education, or healthcare-related content

* experience creating accessible captions, transcripts, alt text, or readable graphics

* familiarity with PDA, autism, ADHD, low-demand communication, or disability-affirming language

* experience organizing content libraries in Google Drive, Dropbox, Notion, Trello, Asana, or ClickUp

* basic understanding of social media scheduling tools



This role is not a fit if you:



* want to own content strategy or d
 the marketing direction

* are mainly interested in viral trends or hype-style social media

* prefer flashy edits over clear and accessible content

* rely on generic AI captions without carefully reviewing and editing them

* think accessibility means “just add captions”

* want to give advice in comments or DMs

* are casual with deadlines, file names, or organization

* need step-by-step instructions for every small task

* are uncomfortable with feedback or revisions

* are uncomfortable working with healthcare-adjacent or neurodivergence-related content

* use shame, fear, urgency, or pressure as primary marketing tools



Example weekly tasks may include:



For one weekly podcast episode, you may help create:



* one edited podcast episode

* one cleaned transcript

* one episode description

* one show notes draft

* three short-form video clips/reels

* captions for each clip

* one to two quote graphics, audiograms, or carousel drafts

* alt text for visual assets

* organized files ready for review

* a short note flagging any questions, concerns, or suggested edits



Important boundaries:



Because this content may connect to healthcare, children, families, and clinical education, confidentiality and professional boundaries are essential.



You must not share private information, use identifiable patient details, provide medical advice, or respond to clinical questions independently. Anything that seems clinically sensitive, potentially identifiable, unclear, or outside the provided guidance should be flagged for review.



All content must be reviewed and approved before publishing unless otherwise agreed.



Pay: $8–$14/hour depending on experience, with an expected starting workload of 10–15 hours/week. Monthly retainer available after a paid trial.



Possible starting range:

10–15 hours/week



This may be structured as hourly pay or a monthly retainer after a paid trial period.



To apply



Please start your message with: ACCESS FIRST



Then answer:



1. What experience do you have with podcast editing, video editing, or repurposing long-form content into short-form clips?



2. Have you supported a podcast, YouTube channel, clinician, educator, coach, therapist, or healthcare/wellness-related business before?



3. What tools do you use for audio editing, video editing, captioning, transcript cleanup, graphics, and file organization?



4. What does accessibility mean to you when creating video, podcast, or social media content?



5. How do you d
 what makes a good short-form clip from a longer podcast or video?



6. How do you preserve the creator’s voice instead of making captions or clips sound generic?



7. What would you do if a parent commented on a video asking, “Do you think my child has PDA, and what should I do?”



8. Are you available for a stable part-time role of 10–15 hours/week?



9. What is your hourly rate or monthly rate for 10–15 hours/week?



Please also include:



* your resume or brief work history

* 2–3 relevant work samples

* your availability

* your internet speed

* the tools/software you already use



Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid test task.



Paid test task may include:



* editing a short podcast or video sample

* creating one to two short-form clips

* adding captions

* drafting captions for each clip

* creating a brief show notes draft

* creating one simple quote graphic or audiogram

* providing alt text

* organizing files in a shared folder

* sharing a brief note about accessibility choices and anything that should be reviewed before posting



What I’m looking for:



The best fit is someone who is reliable, careful, kind, organized, and able to balance creativity with boundaries.



Strong applications will show:



* careful reading of this post

* clear examples of relevant production work

* thoughtfulness about accessibility

* good judgment around healthcare-adjacent content

* warm, respectful language

* organized communication

* understanding that this is a production role, not a strategy role

* comfort with feedback and revisions

* ability to make content clear without making it sensationalized



Applications that are generic, overly salesy, or focused mostly on “going viral” are unlikely to be the right fit.

title: Calling All IG & FB Content EXPERTS
description:
We're looking for a Social Media Platform Manager to own our presence across YouTube, Instagram, and
 — someone who knows these platforms inside and out, lives in the data, engages with our audience, and reports back on what's actually working.

The compensation is $1,200–$1,600 USD/month, depending on experience, with room above the band for someone who can also manage the director's LinkedIn presence.

This is a fully remote role based in the Philippines.

We're a digital marketing agency focused on helping local trades and service businesses grow through search. By 2026, our goal is to become the most trusted name in Local SEO across New Zealand, the USA, and Australia for service businesses.

We've just built out an in-house content engine of 13 editors. The director is actively building his personal brand, and we're about to start publishing long- and short-form content around our deliverables to drive client acquisition. The production side is handled — what we need now is someone to own distribution and performance: get the right content onto the right platforms, engage with the audience it brings in, and tell us clearly what's landing and why.

This is where the Social Media Platform Manager role comes into play.

Knowing each platform in genuine depth, you understand how YouTube, Instagram, and
 actually work, how their algorithms reward content, how each format behaves, and you stay current as these platforms shift

Publishing and managing content across all platforms, organising the posting schedule and making sure nothing the content team produces sits unpublished

Formatting and optimising every piece for the platform it's going on, the specs, aspect ratios, hooks, and conventions each one rewards

Actively engaging on the platforms, replying to comments, interacting with the audience, and building genuine community around our content rather than just broadcasting it

Reviewing performance data across every platform and reporting back clearly, what's working, what isn't, what we should double down on, and what each platform is telling us

Working directly with the director to build a custom dashboard, plus any automations and tools you need to make the role easier, this is how we operate across every department at OPT, we build the systems that remove the grind

Keeping a consistent publishing rhythm so our presence never goes quiet

Spotting trends and surfacing timely opportunities, this isn't the creative lead role, but you're close enough to each platform to flag what we should jump on

Potentially managing the director's LinkedIn presence, if you've got the experience there



Skills We're Looking For

This role is equal parts platform expert, community manager, and analyst. You don't need to create the content, we have a 13-editor engine for that, but you do need to know each platform deeply and how to make content perform on it.



Deep, current expertise in how YouTube, Instagram, and
 actually work, algorithms, formats, distribution, and platform-specific best practices, this is the single most important thing we're looking for

A proven track record of growing an audience, channel, or page, with real numbers you can point to

Genuine experience engaging and building community on these platforms, not just scheduling posts

Demonstrated consistency managing a multi-platform posting schedule without things slipping through the cracks

Comfortable living in performance data, reading analytics, identifying top performers, and turning what you see into clear, plain-English reporting

Strong written English and clear communication, you'll be working directly with the director

LinkedIn personal-brand management experience is a bonus, not a requirement



What We Offer



$1,200–$1,600 USD/month, depending on experience, with room above for the right person who can also manage the director's LinkedIn

Fully remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines

A content engine of 13 editors already in motion, so you're set up to focus on distribution, engagement, and performance, not starting from zero

Direct access to the director, and a company that builds custom dashboards, automations, and tools across every department to make your job easier

A fast-growing agency with clear processes and a genuine opportunity to grow as our brand scales

The OPT Digital Team

title: Full-Time Video Editor & AI Content Creator
description:
Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Video Specialist to create raw AI clips and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is an execution role. Not strategy.

You’ll be given clear briefs, proven systems, and step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's) for every task.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay we'll teach the right person.



What You'll Do



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage into high-retention short-form content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts)

- Add captions, overlays, transitions, sound design, and B-roll in CapCut

- Follow brand guidelines and client briefs exactly

- Apply feedback quickly and accurately

- Deliver a consistent daily output, on time

- Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts



AI Clip Generation

- Generate AI video assets using tools like ChatGPT, Grok, and Veo3

- Execute SOPs precisely (prompts, settings, formats are predefined)

- Quality check all outputs (accuracy, artifacts, exports) before submission

- Flag issues and gaps to improve workflows

- Organize and label all assets clearly for handoff



General

- Manage multiple client projects without missing deadlines

- Keep files structured and easy to navigate

- Communicate proactively on progress, timelines, and blockers



Requirements



Must-Haves

- GROWTH MINDSET AND HUNGRY TO LEARN!!!!

- Strong proficiency in English (speaking, reading, writing)

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Experience prompting AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- High attention to detail and quality

- Comfortable following SOPs (execute first, revise/polish second)

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Coachable, fast learner, and willing to adopt new tools

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Agency or content production background

- Strong understanding of short-form performance (hooks, pacing, retention)

- Copywriting experience

- Strong WiFi



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Clear SOPs and briefs, no guesswork

- Training on AI tools for the right candidate

- Direct, respectful communication and fast feedback

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay (If you perform exceptionally well, we will add on top ANOTHER bonus)

- Access to required tools



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2–3 short-form content edits (tiktoks, reels, yt shorts, etc.)

- Short answer (3–5 sentences): What do you do when an SOP is unclear?

- Your timezone + working hours



No portfolio = no review.
